treatment_summary: The plan addresses CKD‑5 secondary to hypertensive nephrosclerosis with cardiovascular risk reduction, anemia, mineral‑bone disorder, and metabolic acidosis. Existing ACE‑I, thiazide, and insulin are continued. New therapies include high‑intensity atorvastatin, ESA (epoetin alfa) after iron repletion, IV ferric carboxymaltose, sevelamer carbonate, alfacalcidol, and sodium bicarbonate. All additions follow NICE NG107/NG203 recommendations, avoid contraindicated drugs, and include monitoring for labs, blood pressure, and potential drug interactions.
